#AI #FintechInnovator  

Pallavi Agarwal — Machine Learning Engineer at FinTech Innovators Ltd. Focused on building scalable solutions where data meets impact.  

Currently designing NLP models to detect fraud patterns, leveraging PyTorch and TensorFlow for real-time analytics. AWS has been my go-to for deploying models that handle high-volume transactions smoothly. Docker streamlines my workflow, ensuring consistent environments across dev and prod.  

Recently collaborated with cross-functional teams to launch a REST API that integrates predictive insights into customer risk assessments. Scikit-learn still holds a special place for quick prototyping, even as I dive deeper into complex architectures.  

Automate, iterate, optimize — that’s how I approach machine learning. GitHub Actions keeps my pipelines running reliably, though I’ll always prefer a good coffee over CI/CD scripts.  

Eager to explore how AI can reshape financial services. Let’s connect and chat about building smarter systems — one line of code at a time.
